name: Animated Blood worms leave unengaged enemies alone and fight their owner's target (#3998)
contract: Animated Blood 573299 summons two Blood Worms 325301 through SummonProperties 61 (ally guardian). Unscripted guardians get AggressorAI and Guardian::InitStats sets REACT_AGGRESSIVE, so the worms pulled any hostile in line of sight. The worms should aid their owner in combat: a hostile the owner has not engaged stays out of combat, and once the owner attacks it the worms damage it without the owner's own swings.

steps.label: Give the worms time to pull the nearby enemy
The enemy the owner has not engaged stays out of combat
The worms damage the enemy their owner attacked
